exposure: Vaginal delivery vs. prelabor cesarean delivery vs. intrapartum cesarean delivery
outcome: Placenta previa in the second pregnancy
cohort: 26,987 nulliparous women with their first two singleton deliveries
finding: Previous prelabor cesarean delivery, but not intrapartum cesarean delivery, was significantly associated with an increased risk of placenta previa in the second pregnancy.
mod_finding: Previous prelabor cesarean delivery was associated with an increased risk of placenta previa in the second delivery.
